name: @researchdatabox/figshare-metadata-inspector
description: Inspect CQU Figshare v2 dataset metadata and generate ReDBox crosswalk reports.

scripts.test: npm run clean --silent && npm run build --silent && mocha "dist/test/**/*.test.js" --ignore "dist/test/**/*.integration.test.js"
